As Proofpoint (PFPT) Stock Price Rose, Holder Avalon Global Asset Management Lifted Stake; Grubhub (GRUB) Shareholder Selkirk Management Has Trimmed Holding as Share Price Rose
May 6, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Selkirk Management Llc decreased its stake in Grubhub Inc. (GRUB) by 16.61% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Selkirk Management Llc sold 26,100 shares as the company’s stock rose 44.05% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 131,000 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.41M, down from 157,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Selkirk Management Llc who had been investing in Grubhub Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $8.63 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.06% or $1.99 $98.78. About 765,583 shares traded. GrubHub Inc. (NYSE:GRUB) has risen 206.92% uptrending. It has outperformed by 195.37% the S&P500.
Avalon Global Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Proofpoint Inc (PFPT) by 20% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Avalon Global Asset Management Llc bought 5,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 22.55% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 30,000 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.66M, up from 25,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Avalon Global Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Proofpoint Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.23 billion market cap company.
